variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by the union {name}.
variants.body:
The union {name} has called a strike. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

Our movement believes a political principle should have something to say about the people who do the work. Collective action deserves serious judgment, including an examination of purpose and responsibility. Neither an instinctive cheer nor an instinctive denunciation is an adequate substitute for a principled position on labour relations.

The conduct of {target} should be examined against the strike call itself. This paper does not assign unreported demands or assume the participation and outcome of the labour action announced here. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
